summary: Pan American Silver filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, as a foreign private issuer, providing an exploration update for its Timmins operations in Ontario. The company reports a $146 million investment for a shaft extension and access drifts to develop new gold resources, with no changes to 2026 guidance. This is a routine operational update on organic growth plans, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms are present; the filing lacks any M&A, activist, strategic review, or capital return event. The registrant is the issuer of a routine operational update.
